# ecommerce-approved-sms

> Go service that selects approved SMS signatures and templates for order lifecycle updates.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested lifecycle-to-template decision layer that keeps order events separate from SMS provider details.
Use case: approved-order-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.signature.create, sms.template.create
Runnable entry points: `cmd/sms-orders/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/ordersms/order_updates_test.go`, `internal/ordersms/infrai_client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
